QUOTE: Persistence: "Always Allow/Deny" calls `PermissionPersister::save_permission`, which adds the pattern under `permissions.allow` or `permissions.deny` in the project YAML. It is idempotent.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer mentions persisting to "the project YAML" via PermissionPersister, but never names config.local.yaml. It also never contrasts that with the in-memory add_permission call.
